title: Account
description: The account in an export of the account, api/account.json (section 4 of the text of the part): its fields that are no secret, its consents and its counters of quota.

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in export/VERSION.

account_id.description: The ID of the account in api, never the sign-in service's UID.

adult_stated_at.description: When the owner stated they are 18 or older; the column is a timestamptz, the documents say a date.

tariff.description: The account's tariff, taken from its invite code, which sets the quota ceilings.

utc_offset_minutes.description: The family's clock offset from UTC in minutes, -720 to 840 in steps of 15; absent before the first request on platform AI.

day_ends_at.description: The end of the family's current quota day.

last_request_on.description: The date of the last request with the account's token, by which an idle account is deleted after 12 months.

items.description: The part of every profile of the account, as in a profile export: one of them.

profile_ids.description: The IDs of the account's profiles, each with its file in profiles/.

items.description: The consents for a child that have no profile yet, waiting or confirmed: one of them.

consents.description: Every consent of the account, in full: the minimal record left after a deletion is none (R117).

items.description: The account's own quota counters; a profile's go in its profile part: one of them.

quota_counters.description: The account's own quota counters; a profile's go in its profile part.
